name: MiniMax
note: Quota only. MiniMax reports one window per model in a list rather than a keyed object, so the window key is the model name. The international endpoint is used; a China-region account should override `quota.endpoint` with api.minimaxi.com in ~/.antarium/harnesses/minimax.json. Model names come back verbatim, so badges/labels are declared for the models MiniMax ships today; an unlisted model still charts, abbreviated from its name. The key is read from MINIMAX_API_KEY when Antarium was started from a shell, and from ~/.antarium/keys/minimax otherwise — an app launched from Finder inherits the launchd session environment rather than a shell's, so the file is the route that always works. The endpoint is published nowhere; checked 2026-09-22, platform.minimax.io/docs/token-plan says only that the quota "is shown as a usage bar in the console". The fixture is the whole of the check.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.
